entry.summary: Security researchers at Dragos used two million fake AI requests to uncover serious vulnerabilities in the AI supply chain, finding at least three compromised providers, hundreds of stolen AWS keys, and marketplace resellers who were simply reading customer requests. entry.title: AI may not work like the human brain after all, scientists discover
entry.summary: AI may not think like the human brain after all, according to a striking new discovery that challenges how scientists understand artificial intelligence. Researchers found that even AI models that closely predict brain activity may rely on internal processes the brain doesn't use, raising important questions about their reliability in neuroscience research.

entry.title: Google's New Gemini 4 Neon Outperforms Claude Opus 5.5 on Several Benchmarks
entry.summary: Google's Gemini 4 model family continues its element-based naming convention, with Carbon, Hydrogen, Argon, and now, Neon.

entry.title: Google's latest AI model is faster, cheaper and smarter than its flagship predecessor from just weeks ago
entry.summary: Google DeepMind has released Gemini 4 Neon, its fourth model in seven weeks, which is nearly 2x faster than its sibling Carbon, outperforms it on most benchmarks and comes in at a significantly lower price.
